name: This_7
short_caption: The robot extends its right arm forward with an open palm to point out or present something nearby, then returns to neutral.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot smoothly lifts its right arm forward and slightly to its right side. It opens its right hand fully, palm facing upward and inward, as if presenting an object or indicating a nearby direction. After a brief pause to hold the gesture, the robot gently lowers the arm and closes its hand back into the resting position.
safety_notes: The robot's right arm extends forward and slightly to the side; ensure no obstacles or visitors are in close proximity to its right front quadrant.
